'''Ecko-Do''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living in [[New Adasta]] on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3636 BBY]] the former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] came to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to murder civilians. After the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] began landing on Ziost, Ecko-Do was along with [[Gil Sontain]] seen near the [[People's Tower]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ecko-Do was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2.<ref name="SWTOR" />
